scripts.dev: bun run build:wasm && bun run --filter @kompass/web dev
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run --filter @kompass/web build
scripts.check: bun run check:engine && bun run check:web && bun run check:pipeline && bun run check:tools
scripts.check:web: bun run build:wasm && biome check . && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.check:engine: cd engine && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
scripts.check:pipeline: cd pipeline && uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check . && uv run --locked pytest
scripts.check:tools: cd tools/komoot && uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check . && uv run --locked pytest
scripts.format: biome check --write . && cd engine && cargo fmt && cd ../pipeline && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix . && cd ../tools/komoot && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
